title: Adds additional enum values for Radar manual reviews
changed: acknowledged and payment_never_settled added to Review.closed_reason
how: Only with fullDiff: compareOpenApi lists Stripe response enum additions as compatible (openResponseEnums), and switchedEnumAdditions (openapi-diff.ts) adds a blocking entry for the new value where traced code switches over the field, assigns it to `never`, or compares it with string literals (`===`, `!==`, `==`, `!=` or `['a'].includes(...)`; analyzer.ts enumChecks, owner decision 6). unmappedBreakingChanges keeps that entry, so scanReviewReason (workflow.ts) stops the run for review and publication is blocked. Other reads need no edit. Without fullDiff nothing is reported.
